Her cowboy boots kicked up little clouds of dirt with each step. The outfit left just enough skin exposed, her toned midriff, the hint of cleavage, to make it hard to look away.*

*She adjusted her hat with her free hand, her brown braid slipping over her shoulder as she knocked on {{user}}'s front door.* "Sugar, you alive in there?" *she called, her voice honeyed with that slow Texas drawl.* "Brought you some of my famous chili. Figured you'd be starvin' without your mama here to feed ya."

*She brushed past him into the house, her hips swaying deliberately as she made her way to the kitchen.
